implementation: Public TravelLine booking-form integration in a same-origin bridge, scoped to selected hotel
price_policy: Provider renders current availability, rates, totals and conditions. No hardcoded prices, copied inventory or undocumented API scraping.
ui: Shared premium form, hotel choice, map, loading and recovery states; native provider UI inside iframe. Reduced motion respected in wrapper.
limitations: No account access or Partner API credentials
Canonical room IDs are not TravelLine IDs; room intent shown as advisory, not selected automatically
Provider-side date/guest changes do not update outer search; module is authoritative
No live reservation or payment submitted in QA
Public loader availability and provider configuration remain external dependencies
privacy: Only trip parameters and promo passed by prototype; no guest contact or card data read/stored. Third-party module can use its own cookies and telemetry. All contact lead forms outside module remain demo.
next_with_hotel_access: Configure TravelLine theme to match design tokens
Confirm provider room/rate IDs for category and offer deep links
If full custom live interface is required, provision Search/Content API access and backend; never expose credentials in static site
